{{Top|leg}}
[[Blaine Harris]], the [[Deputy Prime Minister]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], kept '''private chambers''' somewhere in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]]. His partner-in-crime [[Salkeli]] brought the [[Sleep/Legends|unconscious]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] there to be interrogated by Harris shortly before the [[Battle of Bakura (28 ABY)|battle of Bakura]]. The freedom fighter [[Malinza Thanas]] and two of her comrades arrived shortly after, and were put into [[Binders/Legends|binders]] along with Solo.
